SELECT
    ISNULL(SUM(exception_row_count), 0)                                                          AS ExceptionCount,
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_severity = 'Critical' THEN exception_row_count ELSE 0 END), 0)  AS CriticalCount,
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_category = 'FAULT_STATE'    THEN exception_row_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS FaultCount,
    ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_category = 'NULL_INJECTION' THEN exception_row_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NullCount,
    ISNULL(SUM(total_lost_revenue_inr), 0)                                                          AS TotalLostRevenue,
    ISNULL(MAX(pct_of_daily_rows), 0)                                                               AS MaxExceptionRate,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.raw_ev_telemetry
     WHERE CAST(timestamp AS DATE) = '@{pipeline().parameters.pipeline_date}')                      AS RawCount
FROM dbo.gold_ev_exception_summary
WHERE data_date = '@{pipeline().parameters.pipeline_date}';
